title: CrowdStrike and Partners Launch Agentic AI Security Accelerator

tickers.name: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Up to 10 finalists from a new startup cohort will pitch their security products at RSAC 2027 to compete for investment from the Falcon Fund. The 2027 intake of a global cybersecurity accelerator by CrowdStrike, AWS, and Nvidia focuses on companies building for the agentic AI era, providing access to the Falcon Foundry, AWS technical and go-to-market support, and Nvidia Inception resources.

This fourth iteration of the partnership has supported more than 90 startups to date, which have collectively raised nearly $1B. Shares of CrowdStrike rose 1.9% in premarket trading following the announcement.

selectedTweets.text:
Crowdstrike $CRWD is expanding its cybersecurity startup accelerator with AWS and Nvidia, with the 2027 program focused on startups building for the agentic AI era.

Participants will get access to CrowdStrike’s Falcon Foundry and APIs, AWS technical and go-to-market support, and NVIDIA Inception resources.

The program has supported more than 90 startups to date, which have collectively raised nearly $1B. 

Up to 10 finalists will pitch at RSAC 2027, with participants also eligible for potential investment from CrowdStrike’s Falcon Fund.
